data: What is the value represented by the darkest pink colored square in the confusion matrix shown in Figure 4?

The darkest pink colored square corresponds to the cell with the value 16. This can be verified by checking the color scale on the right side of the figure, which indicates that darker shades of pink correspond to higher values. The value 16 is located in the bottom left cell of the confusion matrix, where the true label is UNT and the predicted label is TIN. Therefore, the value represented by the darkest pink colored square is 16.
